name: Hidden Parameter & Debug Switch Miner
description: High-throughput hidden parameter and debug switch discovery engine for bug bounty hunters. Detects unlinked GET/POST query parameters, administrative overrides (?admin=true, ?role=admin, ?debug=1), HTTP parameter pollution (HPP), and unkeyed headers through differential response analysis.
author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

probe_get_params.description: Probe for hidden GET query parameters

probe_post_params.description: Probe for hidden POST body parameters (form-urlencoded and JSON)

probe_debug_flags.description: Check for common developer debug flags (debug, test, admin, trace, verbose)
